instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Regional public health authority responsible for epidemiological surveillance, health promotion programs, and healthcare resource planning for a region of 1.2 million inhabitants. Managing 15 public health programs. Key innovation priority is real-time disease surveillance using syndromic data integration from primary care and hospital networks. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: We operate in a consolidating market where competitors are merging to gain economies of scale. Our independent position is increasingly vulnerable. We need to proactively strengthen our competitive positioning — either by deepening our specialization in high-margin niches where scale matters less, or by building platform-like switching costs that make our offering stickier for existing customers.
answers.additionalContext: The authority faces significant challenges integrating legacy paper-based patient data systems with modern AI analytics capabilities. There is currently a strong internal culture favoring stability over rapid, large-scale technology adoption.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: Syndromic Data Dashboard Pilot (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Integrating preliminary syndromic data streams into a single operational dashboard will immediately improve real-time situational awareness for the leadership team. This is low-risk and leverages existing digital tools.

first_actions: Select one high-priority disease (e.g., seasonal flu) for pilot integration.
Define required data fields from primary care and hospital systems.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual reporting time by 30% within Q2.
milestones: Functional dashboard deployed for internal use (Month 2).

opportunities.title: Predictive Resource Allocation Platform (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a machine learning model that predicts future resource needs (beds, supplies) based on demographic shifts and historical disease trends. This radical move creates powerful switching costs by providing a unique competitive advantage in proactive crisis response.

first_actions: Form a dedicated cross-functional 'Innovation Squad' with strong analytical talent.
Identify necessary data pipeline infrastructure investment.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Model accuracy of 85% in predicting hospital bed demand with less than 1-week lead time.
milestones: Internal beta testing with 3 major hospitals (Month 9).

opportunities.title: Standardized Compliance Automation Suite
opportunities.rationale: Automate routine reporting and compliance checks for public health mandates using RPA (Robotic Process Automation). This addresses budget constraints by focusing on internal process efficiency.

execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in compliance error rate by 50%.
milestones: Compliance workflow automation implemented for one program (Month 3).

next_steps.action: Establish the Innovation Steering Committee and define clear KPIs for the Syndicate Data Dashboard pilot.
Conduct a technical feasibility study for the Predictive Resource Allocation Platform, focusing on data governance needs.

key_weaknesses: High reliance on 'partial' innovation process which leads to siloed initiatives and lack of scalable governance.
Severe constraints in budget (9%) limiting large, high-impact radical bets necessary for market defense.
Talent gap between existing operational staff and specialized data science/AI skills required for predictive modeling.
Slow decision-making cycles due to the 'small_leadership_team' structure, hindering agility under 'high' competitive pressure.
